cards.ex: She was on cloud nine after getting the job offer.
cards.exUz: U ish taklifini olgandan keyin baxtdan yetti osmonda edi.

cards.ex: I needed to get that off my chest; it was bothering me for weeks.
cards.exUz: Men buni aytishim kerak edi; bu meni haftalar davomida bezovta qilayotgan edi.

cards.ex: It's not healthy to bottle up your emotions; you need to talk about them.
cards.exUz: O'z his-tuyg'ularingizni yashirish sog'lom emas; siz ular haqida gaplashishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'z his-tuyg'ularini ichga yashirib, tashqariga chiqarmaslik.

cards.ex: He's been down in the dumps since his girlfriend broke up with him.
cards.exUz: U qiz do'sti bilan ajrashganidan beri tushkun ahvolda.
cards.uzDef: Tushkun, kayfiyati yo'q, xafa holatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: After losing his job and his house, he felt like he had hit rock bottom.
cards.exUz: Ishidan va uyidan ayrilganidan keyin, u tubiga yetgandek his qildi.
cards.uzDef: Eng yomon ahvolga tushib qolmoq, eng past nuqtaga yetmoq.

cards.ex: She was a nervous wreck before her presentation.
cards.exUz: U taqdimotidan oldin juda asabiy edi.

cards.ex: I just asked a simple question, and he bit my head off!
cards.exUz: Men shunchaki oddiy savol berdim, va u menga jahl bilan javob berdi!
cards.uzDef: Kimdirga birdaniga jahl bilan, qattiq gapirmoq.

cards.ex: We had a blast at the party last night.
cards.exUz: Biz kecha kechada zo'r vaqt o'tkazdik.

cards.ex: This traffic is driving me crazy!
cards.exUz: Bu tirbandlik meni jinni qilmoqda!

cards.ex: I'm sick and tired of your excuses.
cards.exUz: Men sizning bahonalaringizdan charchadim.

cards.ex: I can't stand people who are always late.
cards.exUz: Men har doim kechikadigan odamlarni yoqtirmayman.

cards.ex: Getting the project done was a weight off my shoulders.
cards.exUz: Loyihani tugatish mening yelkamdan og'irlikni olib tashladi.

cards.ex: She was green with envy when she saw my new car.
cards.exUz: U mening yangi mashinamni ko'rganda hasaddan yashillashdi.

cards.ex: I had a gut feeling that something was wrong.
cards.exUz: Menda nimadir noto'g'ri ekanligi haqida ichki sezgi bor edi.

cards.ex: He lost his temper when I accidentally deleted his files.
cards.exUz: Men tasodifan uning fayllarini o'chirib tashlaganimda, u jahlini yo'qotdi.

cards.ex: I've been on edge all day waiting for the exam results.
cards.exUz: Men imtihon natijalarini kutib butun kun davomida xavotirda bo'ldim.

cards.ex: My heart sank when I heard the news.
cards.exUz: Men bu yangilikni eshitganimda, qalbim cho'kdi.
cards.uzDef: Umid yo'qolganini his qilish, umidsizlikka tushish.

cards.ex: She was over the moon when she found out she was pregnant.
cards.exUz: U homilador ekanligini bilganida oydan ham balandda edi.

cards.ex: I've been feeling a little blue lately.
cards.exUz: Men yaqinda biroz xafa bo'lib yuribman.

cards.ex: With all these bills, it's hard to keep my head above water.
cards.exUz: Bu barcha to'lovlar bilan yashashga harakat qilish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchiliklar bilan kurashish, yashashga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Don't lose sleep over it; it's not worth it.
cards.exUz: Bu haqda uxlashni yo'qotmang; bunga arzimaydi.

cards.ex: I have mixed feelings about moving to a new city.
cards.exUz: Mening yangi shaharga ko'chib o'tishim haqida aralash hislarim bor.
cards.uzDef: Turli xil, qarama-qarshi his-tuyg'ularni his qilish.

cards.ex: He took it hard when he didn't get the promotion.
cards.exUz: U lavozimga ko'tarilmaganida buni qiyin qabul qildi.

cards.ex: She burst into tears when she heard the news.
cards.exUz: U bu yangilikni eshitganida yig'lab yubordi.

cards.ex: He's such an eager beaver, always volunteering for extra work.
cards.exUz: U juda intiluvchan, har doim qo'shimcha ish uchun o'zini taklif qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Juda xohish bilan ishlashga tayyor, juda intiluvchan.

cards.ex: You'll never grow if you don't step outside your comfort zone.
cards.exUz: Agar siz o'z qulaylik hududingizdan tashqariga chiqmasangiz, hech qachon o'smaysiz.
cards.uzDef: O'zini xavfsiz va qulay his qiladigan holat.

cards.ex: His reaction was a little over the top, don't you think?
cards.exUz: Uning reaksiyasi biroz haddan oshiq edi, deb o'ylamaysizmi?

cards.ex: I really feel for her; she's going through a tough time.
cards.exUz: Men unga haqiqatan ham achinaman; u og'ir davrni boshidan kechirmoqda.

cards.ex: She turned the tables on her opponent with a clever move.
cards.exUz: U aqlli harakat bilan raqibiga qarshi vaziyatni o'zgartirdi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni teskarisiga o'zgartirmoq, ustunlikni qo'lga kiritmoq.

cards.ex: I cried my eyes out watching that movie.
cards.exUz: Men bu filmni tomosha qilib, to'yib yig'ladim.
